prompt:
Score each onboarding change. Sub-scores:
- impact 0-3: how many users the targeted step loses and how much this could recover
- evidence 0-3: whether the funnel and the support mail both point at this problem
- confidence 0-2: how likely this kind of change works, judged from the lessons below
- cost 0-2: 2 = config only, 0 = needs new screens and a release
Also give predicted_lift: expected relative change in the target step's conversion, e.g. 0.05.

Lessons from earlier weeks:
Evidence remains thin for single-test change kinds (adoption layout, choose_path hint, home layout, home new_screen, sign_in incentive, sign_in layout).
Adoption redesigns and sign-in hints were helpful, generating multiple winning tests; home wait info, home notifications, and sign-in redesigns also proved helpful by yielding winning tests.
Copy changes on path selection (choose_path copy) and finish screens (finish copy), along with adding new finish screens (finish new_screen), consistently hurt performance.
Home redesigns, home hints, finish hints, choose_path layouts, and finish redesigns consistently showed no clear effect across tests.
Predictions were generally too high overall, but underestimated unexpected winning layout redesigns, hints, and wait info changes.

Changes:
0: [sign_in, redesign] Two-column layout redesign for sign-in screen: Redesign the sign-in screen into a side-by-side two-column layout separating sign-in options from pet account benefits. (why: Sign-in layout redesigns have yielded winning tests in prior rounds, and sign-in drop-off remains a key funnel bottleneck.)
1: [sign_in, hint] Account recovery guarantee hint on sign-in screen: Add a clear hint on the sign-in screen explaining that signing in connects your current pet safely to your account. (why: Support received 8 emails regarding pets missing or resetting after signing in again.)
2: [home, wait_info] Desktop tip carousel component on waiting screen: Add an interactive tip carousel component on the waiting screen sharing quick desktop interaction shortcuts while loading. (why: Wait info changes on the home step have yielded past test wins, helping educate users before desktop spawn.)
3: [adoption, layout] Compact layout redesign for photo upload screen: Redesign the photo upload screen into a compact layout with streamlined controls for uploading custom images. (why: Adoption layout redesigns are proven to generate winning tests and reduce hesitation during pet customization.)
4: [home, notification] Desktop readiness alert notification on waiting screen: Enable a system readiness alert notification switch on the waiting screen to inform users when their pet spawns. (why: Home notifications have provided winning tests previously, preventing drop-offs when desktop initialization takes time.)
5: [finish, hint] Tray navigation control hint on home intro screen: Add a guidance hint on the home intro screen clarifying how to locate and control the pet via the system tray. (why: Multiple support tickets mentioned post-onboarding confusion regarding how to locate, talk to, or manage the pet.)

scores.note: Sign-in step has low drop-off; layout redesigns require significant dev effort with modest historic lift.
Strong evidence from support emails and history shows sign-in hints reliably boost conversion at low cost.
Wait info changes have proven positive track record during long home load times, but component building has cost.
Adoption step has high retention; single past layout test showed negative lift with thin evidence.
Home notifications consistently yield winning tests to keep users engaged during desktop load times.
Finish step is the biggest funnel bottleneck with direct support complaints; simple hint offers strong lift potential at low cost.
